name: MAC97A6
description: A small 0.6A sensitive-gate triac in TO-92, triggerable directly from MPU/logic outputs. Note the gate is the CENTER pin, unlike many triacs. The A6 suffix is the 400V grade.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: pin 1 (MT1), pin 2 (GATE, center), pin 3 (MT2). No tab. onsemi CASE 29-11 STYLE 12.

typical_application: Low-current AC switching driven straight from MPU/TTL/logic outputs: solid-state relays, light consumer and industrial loads.
gotchas: the A6 suffix is 400V; do not assume 600V (that is the A8), A4 is 200V
the GATE is the MIDDLE pin (pin 2), unlike triacs where the gate is an end pin; mind orientation
0.6A RMS only; this is a sensitive-gate signal triac, not a power device
